title: Checkpoint: scams, brokers and your progress review

questions.prompt: A fictional "account manager" asks for your MetaTrader login to "help". What do you do?

options.text: Share it if it is only a demo account
options.explanation: No: never share MetaTrader logins with anyone.
Right: no genuine helper needs your login.
Right: no one can guarantee trading returns.
No: that is an honest warning.

questions.prompt: You lost money to a fake platform. Someone offers to recover it for an upfront fee. What do you do?

options.text: Pay the fee, since getting most of the money back is worth a small cost
options.explanation: No: never pay to recover money. This is a recovery scam.

options.text: Refuse and report the loss through official channels
options.explanation: Right: an upfront recovery fee is a second scam.

questions.prompt: How should you check a broker's regulation?

options.text: Trust the licence number and regulator logo shown on the broker's own website
options.explanation: No: numbers and logos can be copied.

options.text: Search the regulator's official register yourself and match every detail
options.explanation: Right: the official register, reached by you and not through a link you were sent, is the check that counts.

options.text: Ask a signal group if it is safe
options.explanation: No: chat groups are not a reliable source.

questions.prompt: A chat suddenly fills with hype about a tiny coin "about to explode". What might this be?

options.explanation: Right: hype to push the price up so the promoters can sell.
No: sudden hype about a small asset is a warning sign.

questions.prompt: What does the Practice Progress Review give you?

options.text: A "ready to trade" badge once you pass every checkpoint and your demo trades make a profit
options.explanation: No: it shows no "ready" badge, never uses profit, and is never a readiness verdict.

options.text: What you have studied and practised, and which gaps remain, with links to practise them
options.explanation: Right: it is a learning assessment, with no pass or fail.
